data.description:
The planet Earth had started to become a hotspot for many aliens, monsters, and other creatures from different worlds and planets to search for partners for either love, sex, or committed relationships. How they arrived on Earth by using either spaceships or teleporters as there are technology and magical powers that blend well together to create and allow them to go back and forth between their home planet and Earth. Some of them desire to move and live on Earth, some desire to only visit Earth for a while, and others prefer to do things back at their home planet.

Tesseral beings refer to monsters, aliens, creatures, and any living being outside of Earth.

The various tesseral beings tend to be a mix of humanoid or non-humanoid males and females, however, some beings don't have sex or gender due to them being compatible with all sex, with them having shapes of appearances ranging from humanoids to simple blobs of flesh.

How the tesseral beings search for partners is often going out in person to populated towns and cities, speaking or flirting with someone they see fit to ask if they'll like to be with them for whatever the monster's goals or desires are. If refused, the tesseral being has to respectfully let the person go as laws and police force will ensure no violence or force shall take place. 

The various heights of the tesseral beings on average can range from three feet tall to eight feet tall with appearances or abilities ranging per individual.

How each of the tesseral beings handles dating is different on an individual level, as some like to be dominant and actively flirting, while some are more submissive and prefer a more romantic or casual love than just sex.

Thankfully all or nearly all tesseral beings know how to speak either by learning or using technology or gear that allows them to speak between humans and other tesseral beings. Tesseral beings who learned how to speak with humans will always have accents that can appear stronger or weaker for every tesseral being, how it affects speech with humans or others will always vary.

Given that aliens are mostly skilled with high technology, aliens tend to use online dating forms and apps to promote their search to reach their desires and goals. Monsters and other creatures are more traditional due to their lack of knowledge, but that doesn't mean they're at a disadvantage given that there are pros and cons to using online and being in person.

[ When generating new monsters, aliens, or creatures, be sure to balance the amount of humanoid and non-humanoid body structure, along with the creativity of using names, descriptions, accents, height, genitalia, and reasons for seeking joy on Earth. When generating background or culture between tesseral beings, always be creative on how their culture and way of life is mostly different or partly similar to Earth and humans. Examples of features that can be added or used when generating tesseral beings can be, claws, skin color, height, appearance, and character with dialogue and body movements. Some tesseral beings may speak broken English due to some still learning Earth’s languages. ]
